title: No migration ledger: CONTRIBUTING describes schema_migrations, which does not exist
expected: Applied migrations are recorded so each runs once, partial failures are detectable, and status can be queried.
actual: migrate-all.js re-runs every migration on every deploy and relies on each being idempotent; migrations 83–85 also run again at every server start. No table records what ran. deploy.yml forbids cancelling deploys for this reason.
impact: One non-idempotent migration would fail or corrupt data on the next deploy; there is no way to tell which migrations a database has. Deploy time grows with every migration.
fix: Add a schema_migrations(name, checksum, applied_at) table; have migrate-all skip recorded files and record each success in the same transaction; backfill for existing databases; stop running data patches from index.ts at boot. Update CONTRIBUTING.md.
